Title: Taking charge to bring change
NewsSummary: Eight IED graduates qualify the competitive Federal Public Service Commission exams to get appointed as heads of government schools in Gilgit Baltistan.
NewsContent:
Eight IED graduates qualified the competitive Federal Public Service Commission exams to get appointed as heads of government schools in Gilgit Baltistan. Of 900+ applicants, our graduates were among the 28 candidates who qualified the competitive exams to take the school leadership roles. As leaders, they are determined to enable change and reform their schools. The outstanding performance of these graduates in the exams highlights the quality of IED's Master's programmes which prepare graduates to become catalysts for educational change.

"I secured third position in the Federal Public Service Commission examination and have been appointed as a principal (BS-18) in Rahimabad Gilgit, shared Sajjad Khan, a graduate of our MPhil in Education programme.  "The mind shift I experienced at IED had a profound role in motivating me and enabling me to take up this challenging role", he said.

We congratulate all these graduates on their appointment and wish them success in their efforts to improve the educational opportunities for children in their communities.
